verdict.rationale: Stripe's hosted MCP server documents a generic `stripe_api_write` tool, and its supported-method list explicitly covers creating products, prices and payment links. An agent can therefore provision all three objects through the API within one OAuth-authenticated session, and a probe confirms the remote MCP server is live and OAuth-gated. Agents can also obtain an anonymous sandbox with working API keys via the CLI, so the flow can run without touching live mode. Missing for 10: a documented end-to-end walkthrough chaining product → price → payment link in one agent session, and independent hands-on corroboration of that flow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new product, price, and payment link via the API in a single session

citations.quote: `stripe_api_write` ("Write data with any Stripe API POST, PATCH, PUT and DELETE method")
The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API
Coding agents should install the Stripe CLI (npm i -g @stripe/cli) and run the command stripe sandbox create --help to provision an anonymous Stripe sandbox with working API keys.
